title: List Card
description: An ordered or unordered list with optional item actions. Also supports a live `data_source` pointer (composition target for the retired standalone `todo-list` type — see TASKS/phase-6/01-rebuild-todo-list-as-composition.md — and the retired standalone `plan-review` type — see TASKS/phase-6/02-rebuild-plan-review-as-composition.md) so the frontend can re-fetch items at render time instead of trusting a static snapshot.

id.description: Stable item identifier (e.g. a todo id). Required for a `status` item to be independently toggleable by a live data source.

status.description: Checkbox/done-state for a todo-style item (pending/done), or a plan-step state (pending/in_progress/done/skipped) when `data_source.kind` is "plans". When present the item renders a checkbox instead of a bullet/number. Omit for a plain (non-checkable) list item.

items.description: List items. May be an empty placeholder array when `data_source` is set — the frontend re-fetches the real items live and does not trust this snapshot in that case.

ordered.description: Whether to show numbered list. Defaults to false.

data_source.description: Optional live-data-source pointer. When present, the frontend re-fetches items from this source at render time (and re-fetches again after each mutation) instead of trusting the static `items` array above.

kind.description: The live-data-source kind. "todos" re-fetches via the todo store, scoped by `scope`/`scope_id`, and enables per-item toggle through the same mutation the old standalone `todo-list` envelope used. "plans" re-fetches a single plan's steps via `plan_id` and enables per-step toggle through the same mutation the old standalone `plan-review` envelope used.

scope.description: Todo scope (e.g. turn, session, project, workspace). Only used when kind="todos".

scope_id.description: Scope ID (session_id for turn/session; project_id for project). Only used when kind="todos".

plan_id.description: Plan id to re-fetch live. Required when kind="plans".
